conditions: Show the attribution on the Credits screen using incompetech's template: "Penumbra Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) / Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 / https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/". If the app edits the file (trims it, re-encodes it, or adds a crossfade loop point) rather than just repeating it, the hosted file counts as Adapted Material, so the credit should also say it was modified (CC BY 4.0 s3(a)(1)(B)). Do not put DRM on the hosted file that stops recipients from using their CC rights (s2(a)(5)(C)). A public R2 bucket is fine.
